newsitem.title: CANADA: CanOxy in Indonesia exploration contract.
newsitem.headline: CanOxy in Indonesia exploration contract.

text.p: Canadian Occidental Petroleum Ltd said on Tuesday it signed a production sharing contract covering operations on the Offshore Seram Block in eastern Indonesia.
CanOxy said said the block covers an area totalling about 14,800 square km off the north coast of the Island of Seram, with most prospective portions in less than 200 metres of water.
The company said it holds a 100-percent interest and will be operator.
"The Offshore Seram Block is among the most attractive open exploratory acreage in eastern Indonesia," CanOxy president and chief executive David Hentschel said in a statement.
"The Production Sharing Contract provides exposure to large potential reserves and features attractive, frontier fiscal terms."
The company said it planned a 2,000-km seismic program starting in early 1997, followed by a field geologic assessment in the middle of the year.
